summary: Scenario SY04 started: An actuator channel fails

scenario.name: An actuator channel fails
scenario.description: The Brain's actuator channel stops delivering commands (fault injected on the Brain side); a traffic signal fails (INCIDENTS trigger signal_failure) and the Brain tries to restart it.
scenario.trigger: python scenarios/run.py SY04   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)

expected.twin: A signal failure; it does not receive the restart.
expected.brain: Sends the command, logs the failure on the same trace, does not hammer it (retries only after the cooldown).
